# Completed correlation producer

This core-only fixture fits the disposable corpus inputs checked by its owning system gate.
It snapshots the completed numerical correlation pairs before saving: the public numerical
single-fit result, or the scan template's immutable packed covariance table. Its hexadecimal
stdout preserves the observed doubles independently of the saved decimal coefficient text.
These values support a same-fit serialization invariant; they do not claim independent fitted
physics. Historical pair identity, template selection and frozen exact serialization remain
separate witnesses. The fixture links the installed SDK and existing core archive and builds
no application.
